name: chef-imran-hasan-bijoy-portfolio
description: Culinary Portfolio of Chef Md. Imran Hasan Bijoy — Demi Chef de Partie & Multi-Cuisine Specialist

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.cpSync('images', 'public/images', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('css', 'public/css', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('js', 'public/js', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'public/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('cv.html', 'public/cv.html'); fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f => f.endsWith('.pdf')).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/' + f)); console.log('Public build complete');"

author: Md. Imran Hasan Bijoy
